question: Do Mistral API rate limits bind per Workspace or per Organization?
why: docs.mistral.ai/admin/workspaces/usage-limits says rate limits apply at the Workspace level and are shared across its API keys, while help.mistral.ai article 698531 says they are set at the organization level and apply across all workspaces; the binding_note and limits[0].value of both records depend on which is true
